Comedian Duncan Trussell returns to Joe Rogan for episode 2157 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Trussell is the comic mystic whose talks with Rogan roam from God to death with jokes all the way. Fans count his visits as high points of the show.

Trussell and Rogan drift through faith, drugs, love, and the end of days in their warm, wild style. No map guides the talk, and none is missed. Rogan plays host and straight man to his friend. Listeners get a long, kind, strange talk. The library keeps the episode as a record of their bond.
